Its own narrative does not claim delivery: PARTIAL: overload is rejected while the control plane stays healthy. Residual: load-testing simultaneous missions, streaming calls, peer repair and model churn with recorded hardware, and reporting saturation points with cancellation responsiveness, are not enumerated by a named check. Evidence: T-CLAUDE-39. Prove or refute it: add a nonzero test named vc_201_094_mastery_* that exercises the capability on its production path, and record exactly which part is missing when it cannot be proven. Coverage is not mastery: this closes only when the capability is verified, and a linked closed task is not evidence.
